## Diff summary

Prompt 23 connects the accepted UI shell to a strict projection-only decision workflow without adding a browser engine. Drafts are reversible and non-authoritative; Commit and End Month each invoke one durable atomic application operation; save failures keep the prior state/draft; committed journal and ledger history cannot be reordered; preview remains player-known; and a known mandatory response protects the last slot. Fixed happy and adverse browser campaigns complete all four TEST_ONLY months, while production values, hidden forecasts and external review gates remain blocked.
